title: Money, Machines, and Markets
subtitle: Bitcoin, blockchains, AI, and the economy they are reshaping
summary: A working mental model for how sound money, trust-minimized computation, machine intelligence, and the macro system are pulling on the same rope. Not a trading course, not a coding course, not a futurism course. A course about how to think clearly when four large forces converge at once.
learningOutcomes: Define money in terms of its three functions and explain why fiat, Bitcoin, and stablecoins satisfy them differently.
Read the Bitcoin white paper and explain proof-of-work, UTXOs, and the supply schedule from first principles.
Distinguish honest from theatrical decentralization across major blockchain designs.
Describe what a modern large language model is, how it is trained, and what it can and cannot do.
Identify which AI-and-crypto intersections are real engineering problems and which are marketing.
Analyze a macroeconomic event using monetary, technological, and energy lenses simultaneously.
Steel-man the strongest critique of any position you hold in this domain.
